_about: Every place the page sends something other than a plain read, and how its refusals reach the failed-saves log. Checked by test/write-path-refusal-coverage.js. Keys are fragment|function|target|method.

005-head-boot.html.part|(top level)|svBa.note: Boot-time sign-in and client-link checks (key-verify, token verify). They answer "who is this", they save nothing.

040-shared-briefs.js.part|abortForClient.note: Reads the tab summary by POST.

040-shared-briefs.js.part|addHookToLibra.note: Hook library add (n8n webhook). Wrapped: a refused or failed request is recorded as hook_library_add.

040-shared-briefs.js.part|promise|CAL_SU.note: analytics-read: reads analytics rows through the function.

050-market-briefs.js.part|abortForClient.note: Reads the content summary by POST.

050-market-briefs.js.part|sendWeeklySlac.note: Weekly Slack update (n8n webhook). Recorded as weekly_slack_update.

060-templates-filming.js.part|send|url|P.note: Templates > brain. Only the "change" action is a save and is recorded as templates_brain_change; read and folders are reads.

080-workload-render.js.part|_wlDueWriteR.note: Workload due date through the write gateway. Recorded as workload_due_save (the gateway also records its own refusal).
Workload due date, legacy route. Recorded as workload_due_save.

080-workload-render.js.part|_wlPlanWrite.note: Workload plan date save. Recorded as workload_plan_save.

100-onboarding-staff-controls.js.part|_o.note: The public onboarding form saves a draft copy when the visitor leaves. Visitors are not signed in, so a report from that page would be labelled as a staff page; the form has its own backup capture and thank-you or failure screen.
Same draft copy, sent by fetch when a beacon is unavailable.

Shared form post. The staff Sales Intake submit records its failure as sales_intake_submit; the public onboarding form (visitors are not signed in) has its own backup capture and failure screen and is not recorded.

100-onboarding-staff-controls.js.part|_s.note: Staff key verification: answers who is signing in, saves nothing.

112-smm-weekly-reports.js.part|send|url|.note: SMM weekly reports. Reads (GET) are not recorded; a submit or sync is recorded as weekly_report_<action>.

120-calendar-flags-write-repair.js.part|.note: Pinned Calendar upsert transport (status writes, including the client approve path). Not modified; its status writes record through _writeUiReportFailure.
Issuing a client share link (staff only). Recorded as client_link_issue.
This is the failed-saves log beacon itself.

The gateway transport the client approve and request-changes buttons use. Not modified (test/client-review-requests-unchanged-browser.js); its callers record refusals through _writeUiReportFailure / _writeUiRecordFailure.

125-title-name-rule.js.part|_renamePropP.note: Nudges the rename-propagation drain; best effort by design. The rename itself is a gateway write, recorded as title.

125-title-name-rule.js.part|_renamePropR.note: "Retry" for a rename that did not reach the sub-issues; the server drain already logs the failure and the page keeps its own ring entry.

140-calendar-legacy-outbox.js.part|_calC.note: Asks the gateway whether a queued urgent ping was delivered (native_urgent_status).

140-calendar-legacy-outbox.js.part|showU.note: Sending an urgent ping through the gateway. A ping that went out and did not come back confirmed is recorded as urgent_ping.
The pre-gateway urgent webhook path; its send is retired (B2) and only fails closed. The gateway path above is the live one.

160-calendar-organize-ui.js.part|_calFra.note: Calendar Frame folder button: reads the client's saved Frame folder (brain, action folders). Nothing is saved.

170-calendar-links-status.js.part|curren.note: Reads the editor options for the intake picker.

180-calendar-native-post-media.js.part|_.note: "Cancel" for a caption job; the page settles the job locally if it fails.
Starts a caption generation (n8n). A job that ends in error is recorded once as caption_generate, where the job settles.
Stand-down message for a caption job that timed out; the job already ends in error and is recorded there.
Caption prompt save (caption-prompts-save). Recorded as caption_prompt_save.

180-calendar-native-post-media.js.part|p.note: Calendar drag order (calendar-reorder). Recorded as calendar_reorder.

200-intake-data-startup.js.part|_linearI.note: Fire-and-forget submission log to a sheet; not a save the person waits on.

200-intake-data-startup.js.part|_runNati.note: Intake create through the gateway. Already recorded (intake_create and the queue kinds) by its callers.

210-production-state-writes.js.part|_pro.note: Archive repair viewer: the only actions it sends are list and issue.

230-production-create-comments.js.part|_.note: The Production gateway write (status, assignee, due, labels, comments, title, description). Recorded by each caller.
Production create. Recorded as create by its callers.

240-production-description.js.part|_prod.note: Description image upload. Recorded as description_image by its caller.

270-samples-model.js.part|_sxrUpsertFetc.note: Pinned Samples upsert transport (status writes, including the client approve path). Not modified.

299-instagram-upload.js.part|ctrl|cmint..note: Instagram cover image upload to Post For Me storage. Recorded as instagram_cover_put.

299-instagram-upload.js.part|ctrl|mint.j.note: Instagram video upload to Post For Me storage. Recorded as instagram_storage_put.

299-instagram-upload.js.part|send|IG_FUN.note: Instagram upload function (mint, create, list, cancel). Create and cancel are recorded as instagram_create and instagram_cancel; list and mint are reads of state.

300-tiktok-upload.js.part|_tkFinishPhoto.note: TikTok photo post creation. Recorded as tiktok_upload.

300-tiktok-upload.js.part|_tkPutDirect|u.note: TikTok video upload to storage. Recorded as tiktok_storage_put.

300-tiktok-upload.js.part|_tkSubmitPhoto.note: TikTok photo upload address. Recorded as tiktok_photo_upload.
TikTok photo upload to storage. Recorded as tiktok_photo_upload.

300-tiktok-upload.js.part|idempotencyKey.note: TikTok upload, multipart. Recorded as tiktok_upload.

310-sales-intake-hiring.js.part|send|HIR.note: Hiring. list and detail are reads; every other action is recorded as hiring_<action>.

321-kasper-dashboard-replies.js.part|_sp.note: The save-problems page reading the log itself.

321-kasper-dashboard-replies.js.part|sen.note: Client credentials. list and history are reads; every other action is recorded as credentials_<action>.

323-kasper-dashboard-tail.js.part|_caEdi.note: Client profile edit / status / refresh. Recorded as client_profile_<action>.

120-calendar-flags-write-repair.js.part|.note: Calendar upsert transport for the client review link (approve and request changes). Always the calendar-upsert function with the link token (n8n exit step K); test/calendar-client-approve-function-browser.js proves it.

Staff Calendar upsert behind the saving-on check. Not modified; each staff save that uses it records its own failure (see calendar_settings_save, calendar_import, calendar_link_adopt, calendar_archive, kasper_post_save, restore).

186-archived-restore.js.part|_arxGateway.note: Restore moves a work item back through the guarded production-write route. Its caller _arxRestore records a failed move through _arxFail, which reports to the log (surface calendar or sxr, operation status).

186-archived-restore.js.part|_arxRestore.note: Restore position write. A failure is caught in _arxRestore and recorded through _arxFail (step order).

270-samples-model.js.part|_sxrReorderFet.note: Samples drag order (sample-review-reorder), behind the saving-on check. Recorded as sample_reorder.

270-samples-model.js.part|_sxrUpsertFetc.note: Samples upsert transport for the client review link (approve and request changes). Always the sample-review-upsert function with the link token (n8n exit step K); test/samples-client-approve-function-browser.js proves it.
Staff Samples upsert behind the saving-on check (n8n exit PR 4). Each staff save that uses it records its own failure (sample_archive, sample_link_adopt, kasper_sample_save, urgent_marker_save).
